requests.title: When and where to use "learn more"
requests.detail: We need a rule for when and where to use "learn more" as link text. It comes up constantly in marketing and product and we have no consistent guidance.

requests.title: Revisit error message tone guidance
requests.detail: Inferred from agent conversation. User expressed frustration that current error message guidance feels too formal for the product context.

requests.title: Inclusive language guidance for product onboarding
requests.detail: Request to review and update inclusive language guidance specifically for onboarding flows. Current guidance is general and does not address onboarding-specific patterns.
